findings.title: Items and Movable Units read whole moves before showing the first rows
findings.label: safe to fix
findings.expectedGain: Bound first-response rows and enrichment to page size and measure whole-move counts separately.

findings.title: A cold signed-in page waits through account and move lookups
findings.label: safe to fix
findings.expectedGain: Remove serial query rounds from the page's critical path.

findings.title: Each mounted photo thumbnail asks Convex for its own card image
findings.label: safe to fix
findings.expectedGain: Target one signing action and one authorization query for ten eligible covers and transfer smaller renditions.

findings.title: Queue counts reread history, including when the screen discards them
findings.label: safe to fix
findings.expectedGain: Eliminate unused desk counts and avoid rereading processed captures with explicit flags for legacy badges.

findings.title: Some photo links skip the photo's visibility rule
findings.label: safe to fix
findings.expectedGain: Issue zero image capabilities to denied roles and cap sensitive original URLs at one minute.

findings.title: Older connector uploads can finish without checking current connection limits
findings.label: safe to fix
findings.expectedGain: Deny an out-of-scope upload at commit without creating a photo record.

findings.title: An AI edit can rebuild each live recipient packet twice
findings.label: safe to fix
findings.expectedGain: Reduce repeated documentation packet reads toward one shared move data bundle per phase, preserving atomic publication checks.

findings.title: An empty Queue view can page through unrelated capture history
findings.label: safe to fix
findings.expectedGain: Avoid exhausting Answered capture pages to render an empty Waiting on AI view.

findings.title: Covers and gallery images disappear behind the move-wide photo cap
findings.label: safe to fix
findings.expectedGain: Keep eligible record photos visible regardless of how many unrelated photos were uploaded.

findings.title: Move-specific inventory and photo links can open a different move
findings.label: safe to fix
findings.expectedGain: Authorized links consistently select the named move while unavailable links retain a fallback.

findings.title: Opening Admin scans 11 entire tables
findings.label: safe to fix
findings.expectedGain: Bound search and detail reads and reuse exact totals where available, preserving access receipts.

refactorProposals.title: Rewrite inventory browse around bounded rows
refactorProposals.label: safe to fix
refactorProposals.expectedGain: Keep initial row and cover work small as the move grows, using one reusable lookup path.
refactorProposals.verification: Compare full-move search and sort, facets, cross-page selection, thumbnail visibility and large-move read bytes.

refactorProposals.title: Give the workspace one route-aware bootstrap
refactorProposals.label: safe to fix
refactorProposals.expectedGain: Start route data sooner and use one selection policy for membership and deep links.
refactorProposals.verification: Compare cold loads, same-tab move switches, first sign-in with an invite, move-only access, cross-household links, unavailable-link fallback and uninterrupted capture jobs.

refactorProposals.title: Make photo delivery and upload commits share an explicit authority boundary
refactorProposals.label: safe to fix
refactorProposals.expectedGain: Reuse one consistent visibility check for reads and one current-authority check for commits.
refactorProposals.verification: Compare all four connector doors and the browser for role denials, commit-time authority, replay, rendition limits and expiry.
